Markets.summary: India's commercial real estate market is offering new opportunities for institutional investors across office, retail, and warehousing sectors, according to a JLL report. Because cap rates have reached historic lows, future double-digit returns will depend more heavily on rental income growth.

Markets.title: Bitcoin rattled by biggest crypto heist in history! Why Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger hated cryptocurrency
Markets.summary: A reported $6 billion cryptocurrency heist at Binance caused by a compromised laptop has rattled investors. The FBI blamed North Korea for the attack, and Binance stated it will cover the resulting losses.

Markets.title: Big tech share buybacks plunge 83% as AI spending hits cash flows
Markets.summary: Major US technology companies cut their share buybacks and dividends by 83% as record spending on artificial intelligence pushed their cash flows into a deficit. This sharp reduction in shareholder returns increases the pressure on these companies to generate actual profits from their AI investments.

Markets.title: Explained: Why gold investors should tone down expectations as yellow metal plunges to a 1-year low
Markets.summary: Gold prices have dropped more than 30% from their January record high due to rising oil prices, inflation concerns, and expected Federal Reserve rate hikes. Analysts remain cautious about a near-term recovery, though major banks still hold bullish long-term forecasts for 2027.

Markets.title: Nasdaq Outlook: Is the worst over for AI-fuelled tech stocks?
Markets.summary: The Nasdaq suffered its largest single-day drop since June as Wall Street's AI-driven rally encountered a sharp setback. This decline was driven by heavy losses in technology stocks amid growing investor concerns regarding hyperscaler spending and AI investment returns.

Markets.title: Coal India shares jump 4% after firm records highest-ever monthly coal supplies in October
Markets.summary: Coal India shares rose over 4% after the company achieved record-breaking coal production and supplies in October. Total monthly supplies exceeded 70 million tonnes, with power sector deliveries reaching an all-time high of 57.1 million tonnes.

Data & Insights.summary: Gross GST collections grew 23% year-on-year in October, marking the fourth month this fiscal year that revenues exceeded ₹2 trillion. This growth was driven by a surge in import-related taxes and a favourable low statistical base from the previous year.

India.title: 7 States, Rs 20,000: How Women Were Lured Into Egg Donation Racket
